name: rf-grow-co
description: Standalone hobby game, NOT a Farming Simulator product. First-person shop simulator: grow, cure, pack and sell, run a basement cigarette works, fight off robbers, and drive around a small open town.
author: TheCodingDad-TisonK

scripts.check: node tools/sync-version.js && node --check game/grow3d.js && node --check game/grow3d-creative.js && node --check game/menu.js && node --check game/guide.js && node --check game/report.js && node --check main.js
scripts.dist: npm run check && npm run icon && electron-packager . "RF Grow Co" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=build/icon.ico --app-copyright="TheCodingDad-TisonK" --ignore="^/dist" --ignore="^/docs" --ignore="^/screenshots" --ignore="^/tools" --ignore="^/build" --ignore="^/\.github" --ignore="^/\.git" --prune=true
scripts.installer: npm run check && npm run icon && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
